        "contents": "# Git設定確認完了レポート\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-08  \n**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  \n**タスク**: Gitリポジトリを &#96;zapabob/codex&#96; の &#96;main&#96; ブランチに設定\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実施内容\n\n### 1. 現在の設定確認\n\n**リモートリポジトリ設定:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\norigin    https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git (fetch)\norigin    https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git (push)\nupstream  https://github.com/openai/codex.git (fetch)\nupstream  https://github.com/openai/codex.git (push)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**現在のブランチ:**\n- &#96;main&#96; ブランチ（✅ 正しく設定済み）\n\n**同期状態:**\n- &#96;origin/main&#96; と完全に同期済み\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 実施した修正作業\n\n### 問題発見\n初回の &#96;git fetch origin&#96; でリモート参照のロックエラーが発生：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nerror: cannot lock ref 'refs/remotes/origin/main': \n  is at a06d4f5bef72de68a5b5f7a80dfe02b034574c6c \n  but expected ebe706b37de2c5d6d8be7c34f46bab4abe2682ae\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 解決策\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# リモート参照を正しい値に更新\ngit update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main a06d4f5bef72de68a5b5f7a80dfe02b034574c6c\n\n# 最新の変更をpull\ngit pull origin main\n# =&gt; Already up to date.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 最終確認結果\n\n### リポジトリ構成\n- **Origin**: &#96;zapabob/codex&#96; (フォーク先・メインリポジトリ)\n- **Upstream**: &#96;openai/codex&#96; (公式リポジトリ)\n\n### 最新コミット履歴\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\na06d4f5b Add security audit script\n6894cfd7 feat: Add upstream sync script for openai/codex integration\n2d997102 Update Cargo.toml to change edition and add features section\n54e2a0e5 Merge pull request #11 from zapabob/copilot/add-feature-flags-support\nb75b95d9 Initial plan\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 新しく検出されたブランチ\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- copilot/add-feature-flags-support\n- copilot/fix-cicd-errors-and-add-features\n- copilot/integrate-multi-agent-system\n- copilot/prepare-multi-agent-coordination-system\n- feature/node-rust-only\n- feature/upstream-pr-preparation",

        "contents": "# Git設定確認完了レポート\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-08  \n**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  \n**タスク**: Gitリポジトリを &#96;zapabob/codex&#96; の &#96;main&#96; ブランチに設定\n\n---\n\n## 📋 実施内容\n\n### 1. 現在の設定確認\n\n**リモートリポジトリ設定:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\norigin    https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git (fetch)\norigin    https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git (push)\nupstream  https://github.com/openai/codex.git (fetch)\nupstream  https://github.com/openai/codex.git (push)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**現在のブランチ:**\n- &#96;main&#96; ブランチ（✅ 正しく設定済み）\n\n**同期状態:**\n- &#96;origin/main&#96; と完全に同期済み\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 実施した修正作業\n\n### 問題発見\n初回の &#96;git fetch origin&#96; でリモート参照のロックエラーが発生：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nerror: cannot lock ref 'refs/remotes/origin/main': \n  is at a06d4f5bef72de68a5b5f7a80dfe02b034574c6c \n  but expected ebe706b37de2c5d6d8be7c34f46bab4abe2682ae\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 解決策\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# リモート参照を正しい値に更新\ngit update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main a06d4f5bef72de68a5b5f7a80dfe02b034574c6c\n\n# 最新の変更をpull\ngit pull origin main\n# =&gt; Already up to date.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 最終確認結果\n\n### リポジトリ構成\n- **Origin**: &#96;zapabob/codex&#96; (フォーク先・メインリポジトリ)\n- **Upstream**: &#96;openai/codex&#96; (公式リポジトリ)\n\n### 最新コミット履歴\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\na06d4f5b Add security audit script\n6894cfd7 feat: Add upstream sync script for openai/codex integration\n2d997102 Update Cargo.toml to change edition and add features section\n54e2a0e5 Merge pull request #11 from zapabob/copilot/add-feature-flags-support\nb75b95d9 Initial plan\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 新しく検出されたブランチ\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- copilot/add-feature-flags-support\n- copilot/fix-cicd-errors-and-add-features\n- copilot/integrate-multi-agent-system\n- copilot/prepare-multi-agent-coordination-system\n- feature/node-rust-only\n- feature/upstream-pr-preparation",

        "contents": "# Upstream Sync &amp; Merge 対応ログ\n\n**日時**: 2025-11-21 16:36:56  \n**ブランチ**: main  \n**計画**: Upstream Sync &amp; Merge Plan  \n\n## 作業概要\n- &#96;git fetch origin&#96; の後、&#96;git log main..origin/main&#96; と &#96;git diff --stat main origin/main&#96; で差分を把握し重点領域（&#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96;, &#96;codex-rs/tauri-gui/src-tauri/Cargo.toml&#96;, ならびに大量削除された &#96;.specstory/_docs&#96; 系履歴）を整理。\n- &#96;git merge --no-ff -X ours origin/main&#96; を実行して upstream と同期（結果は Already up to date）。\n- &#96;just fmt&#96; が Windows shell 未設定で失敗したため、代替として &#96;cargo fmt --all&#96; を直接実行し整形確認。\n- &#96;cargo test -p codex-cli&#96; を走らせて CLI crate のビルド健全性をチェック（0テスト構成だがビルド/リンク成功）。  \n\n## 詳細メモ\n\n### 1. Assess Divergence\n- ログ＆差分統計で upstream との差異が &#96;Cargo.toml&#96;（2 箇所）と &#96;.specstory&#96; / &#96;_docs&#96; 系大量削除に集中していることを確認。\n- GUI/TUI/CLI の観点で今回差分は Cargo メタデータのみだったため、追加コンフリクトは無しと判断。\n\n**実装状況**: [実装済み]  \n**動作確認**: [未確認]  \n**確認日時**: 2025-11-21  \n**備考**: &#96;git log origin/main..main&#96; でローカルが3コミット先行していることも確認済み。\n\n### 2. Merge origin/main into main\n- &#96;git merge --no-ff -X ours origin/main&#96; を実行。既に fast-forward 状態であったため新規コミットなし。\n- &#96;git status -sb&#96; でマージ後も既存の &#96;.specstory&#96; / &#96;_docs&#96; 変更のみが残っていることを再確認。\n\n**実装状況**: [実装済み]  \n**動作確認**: [未確認]  \n**確認日時**: 2025-11-21  \n**備考**: upstream との乖離ゼロのため reapply 作業不要。\n\n### 3. Stabilize Workspace\n- &#96;just fmt&#96; が shell 検出エラーで停止したため、&#96;cargo fmt --all&#96; を直接実行（nightly 限定オプション警告のみで終了）。\n- &#96;cargo test -p codex-cli&#96; を実施。テストケース自体は未定義だが crate のビルド＆リンクが成功し exit code 0 を確認。",

        "contents": "# Check differences between zapabob/codex and openai/codex\n# 公式リポジトリとの差分を確認\n\nWrite-Host \"=== zapabob/codex ↔ openai/codex 差分チェック ===\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"\"\n\n$repoPath = \"C:\\Users\\downl\\Desktop\\codex\"\nSet-Location $repoPath\n\n# Step 1: Fetch latest from upstream\nWrite-Host \"[1/5] Fetching latest from upstream (openai/codex)...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\ngit fetch upstream 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\nWrite-Host \"  ✓ Fetched\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# Step 2: Show commit difference\nWrite-Host \"&#96;n[2/5] Commit difference...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n$aheadBehind = git rev-list --left-right --count upstream/main...main\n$behindCount = ($aheadBehind -split '\\s+')[0]\n$aheadCount = ($aheadBehind -split '\\s+')[1]\n\nWrite-Host \"  Behind upstream: $behindCount commits\" -ForegroundColor $(if ($behindCount -gt 0) { \"Red\" } else { \"Green\" })\nWrite-Host \"  Ahead of upstream: $aheadCount commits\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n\n# Step 3: Show recent commits on both sides\nWrite-Host \"&#96;n[3/5] Recent commits comparison...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"&#96;n  公式リポジトリ (upstream/main):\" -ForegroundColor Magenta\ngit log --oneline --max-count=5 upstream/main\nWrite-Host \"&#96;n  zapabobリポジトリ (origin/main):\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\ngit log --oneline --max-count=5 main\n\n# Step 4: Show file differences\nWrite-Host \"&#96;n[4/5] File differences...\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\n$diffFiles = git diff --name-status upstream/main...main\n\nif ($diffFiles) {\n    Write-Host \"  Changed files:\" -ForegroundColor White",

        "contents": " // Timeout or error\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn get_git_remotes(cwd: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt; {\n    let output = run_git_command_with_timeout(&amp;[\"remote\"], cwd).await?;\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let mut remotes: Vec&lt;String&gt; = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)\n        .ok()?\n        .lines()\n        .map(str::to_string)\n        .collect();\n    if let Some(pos) = remotes.iter().position(|r| r == \"origin\") {\n        let origin = remotes.remove(pos);\n        remotes.insert(0, origin);\n    }\n    Some(remotes)\n}\n\n/// Attempt to determine the repository's default branch name.\n///\n/// Preference order:\n/// 1) The symbolic ref at &#96;refs/remotes/&lt;remote&gt;/HEAD&#96; for the first remote (origin prioritized)\n/// 2) &#96;git remote show &lt;remote&gt;&#96; parsed for \"HEAD branch: &lt;name&gt;\"\n/// 3) Local fallback to existing &#96;main&#96; or &#96;master&#96; if present\nasync fn get_default_branch(cwd: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    // Prefer the first remote (with origin prioritized)\n    let remotes = get_git_remotes(cwd).await.unwrap_or_default();",

        "contents": "if (Test-Path \"$backupDir/.zapabob-files\") {\n    Get-Content \"$backupDir/.zapabob-files\" | ForEach-Object {\n        $line = $_.Trim()\n        if ($line -and -not $line.StartsWith(\"#\")) {\n            $sourcePath = Join-Path $backupDir $line\n            if (Test-Path $sourcePath) {\n                Write-Host \"  ✅ 復元: $line\" -ForegroundColor Green\n                $destDir = Split-Path $line -Parent\n                if ($destDir -and -not (Test-Path $destDir)) {\n                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destDir -Force | Out-Null\n                }\n                Copy-Item -Path $sourcePath -Destination $line -Recurse -Force\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"&#96;n✅ 復元完了&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# 5. zapabob独自ファイルをステージング\nWrite-Host \"📝 zapabob独自ファイルをステージング中...&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n\ngit add .zapabob-files\ngit add zapabob/\ngit add _docs/\ngit add CHANGELOG.md\ngit add CONTRIBUTING.md\ngit add scripts/setup-pr-review.*\ngit add scripts/README.md\ngit add .github/workflows/pr-review*.yml\ngit add config.toml\ngit add README.md\ngit add LICENSE\n\nWrite-Host \"✅ ステージング完了&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# 6. 統合コミット作成\nWrite-Host \"💾 統合コミット作成中...&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n\ngit commit --amend --no-edit\n\nWrite-Host \"✅ コミット完了&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# 7. 確認\nWrite-Host \"========================================\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nWrite-Host \"  ✅ Upstream同期完了！\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"========================================&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n\nWrite-Host \"📊 次のステップ:&#96;n\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  1. 変更内容を確認: git log --oneline -10\" -ForegroundColor White\nWrite-Host \"  2. テスト実行: cargo test\" -ForegroundColor White\nWrite-Host \"  3. mainブランチに切り替え: git checkout main\" -ForegroundColor White\nWrite-Host \"  4. upstream-syncをマージ: git merge upstream-sync-2025-10-23\" -ForegroundColor White",

        },
        "contents": "# 公式リポジトリ統合作業ログ\n\n**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:25 JST  \n**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  \n**目的**: OpenAI公式Codexリポジトリとの統合を行い、独自機能を尊重しつつ最新版と連携\n\n---\n\n## 📋 作業概要\n\nローカルにダウンロードしたCodexプロジェクトを、公式GitHubリポジトリと統合し、独自機能を保護しつつ最新の更新を取り込める体制を構築したで！\n\n## 🔧 実施した作業\n\n### 1. Git リポジトリの初期化\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit init\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- ローカルディレクトリをGitリポジトリとして初期化\n- 空のリポジトリから開始\n\n### 2. 公式リポジトリの追加\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git\ngit remote add origin https://github.com/openai/codex.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- &#96;upstream&#96;: 公式リポジトリへの参照\n- &#96;origin&#96;: 同じく公式リポジトリ（標準的な命名規則に従う）\n\n### 3. 公式リポジトリの取得\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit fetch upstream\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- 公式リポジトリから全ブランチとタグを取得\n- 300以上のブランチが存在することを確認\n- 最新のタグ: &#96;rust-v0.45.0&#96;, &#96;rust-v0.2.0-alpha.2&#96;\n\n### 4. ローカル状態の保存\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit add .\ngit commit -m \"Initial commit: Local Codex files\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- 1079ファイルをコミット\n- 177,647行の追加を記録\n- コミットハッシュ: &#96;ccfc74e0&#96;\n\n### 5. 独自機能の保護\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit checkout -b feature/local-custom-features\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- 独自機能を保存する専用ブランチを作成\n- &#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリを含むローカルカスタマイズを保護\n\n## 📊 差分分析\n\n### 主な違い\n公式リポジトリ(&#96;upstream/main&#96;)との差分:\n- **291ファイル**に変更あり\n- **+7,253行** 追加\n- **-16,431行** 削除\n\n### 独自機能\n以下のローカル独自機能を確認:\n\n1. **&#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリ**\n   - 実装ログ管理システム",

Deep Research\n- &#96;codex-rs/core/src/research/&#96; - 深層研究機能\n- DuckDuckGo/Brave/Google統合\n\n---\n\n## 🔄 同期頻度推奨\n\n| 同期タイミング | 理由 |\n|--------------|-----|\n| **毎週月曜日** | 公式の週次更新を取り込む |\n| **重要な機能追加時** | 公式の新機能を確認 |\n| **セキュリティパッチ時** | 脆弱性修正を即座に適用 |\n\n---\n\n## 📝 コマンドクイックリファレンス\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# リモート確認\ngit remote -v\n\n# 公式取得\ngit fetch upstream\n\n# 差分確認\ngit log --oneline --graph --all --max-count=20\n\n# マージ\ngit merge upstream/main\n\n# プッシュ\ngit push origin main\n\n# 公式との差分ファイル一覧\ngit diff --name-only upstream/main..main\n\n# 公式との差分統計\ngit diff --stat upstream/main..main\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 将来の統合計画\n\n### Phase 1: 公式へのPR準備\n- [ ] 独自機能を独立ブランチに分離\n- [ ] 公式互換性テスト\n- [ ] ドキュメント整備\n\n### Phase 2: PR提出\n- [ ] サブエージェント機構のPR\n- [ ] オーケストレーション強化のPR\n- [ ] Windows統合のPR（オプション）\n\n### Phase 3: 継続的同期\n- [ ] 自動同期CI/CDパイプライン構築\n- [ ] コンフリクト自動解決スクリプト\n- [ ] 定期マージ自動化\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 現在の状態サマリー\n\n- ✅ リモート設定完了（origin &amp; upstream）\n- ✅ クリーンな履歴構築完了\n- ✅ 大容量ファイル問題解決\n- ✅ 同期準備完了\n- ⏳ 初回マージ未実施（必要に応じて実行）",

        "contents": "# 公式リポジトリ統合作業ログ\n\n**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:25 JST  \n**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  \n**目的**: OpenAI公式Codexリポジトリとの統合を行い、独自機能を尊重しつつ最新版と連携\n\n---\n\n## 📋 作業概要\n\nローカルにダウンロードしたCodexプロジェクトを、公式GitHubリポジトリと統合し、独自機能を保護しつつ最新の更新を取り込める体制を構築したで！\n\n## 🔧 実施した作業\n\n### 1. Git リポジトリの初期化\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit init\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- ローカルディレクトリをGitリポジトリとして初期化\n- 空のリポジトリから開始\n\n### 2. 公式リポジトリの追加\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git\ngit remote add origin https://github.com/openai/codex.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- &#96;upstream&#96;: 公式リポジトリへの参照\n- &#96;origin&#96;: 同じく公式リポジトリ（標準的な命名規則に従う）\n\n### 3. 公式リポジトリの取得\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit fetch upstream\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- 公式リポジトリから全ブランチとタグを取得\n- 300以上のブランチが存在することを確認\n- 最新のタグ: &#96;rust-v0.45.0&#96;, &#96;rust-v0.2.0-alpha.2&#96;\n\n### 4. ローカル状態の保存\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit add .\ngit commit -m \"Initial commit: Local Codex files\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- 1079ファイルをコミット\n- 177,647行の追加を記録\n- コミットハッシュ: &#96;ccfc74e0&#96;\n\n### 5. 独自機能の保護\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit checkout -b feature/local-custom-features\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- 独自機能を保存する専用ブランチを作成\n- &#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリを含むローカルカスタマイズを保護\n\n## 📊 差分分析\n\n### 主な違い\n公式リポジトリ(&#96;upstream/main&#96;)との差分:\n- **291ファイル**に変更あり\n- **+7,253行** 追加\n- **-16,431行** 削除\n\n### 独自機能\n以下のローカル独自機能を確認:\n\n1. **&#96;.specstory/&#96; ディレクトリ**\n   - 実装ログ管理システム",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "6. **詳細ドキュメント** (&#96;zapabob/docs/&#96;)\n   - 日英バイリンガル documentation\n   - アーキテクチャ図（SVG/PNG）\n   - 実機テスト結果\n\n---\n\n## 🛠️ 実施した作業\n\n### Phase 1: 準備（Backup &amp; 情報収集）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# バックアップブランチ作成\ngit branch zapabob-backup-20251019-173835\n\n# upstream同期用ブランチ作成\ngit branch upstream-sync-main\n\n# 未コミット変更をstash\ngit stash push -m \"WIP: .specstory changes before upstream merge\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Phase 2: Upstream Fetch\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit fetch upstream\ngit fetch origin\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**取得した主要upstream変更**:\n- &#96;--add-dir&#96; フラグ追加 (#5335)\n- 独立TurnContexts (#5308)\n- MCP認証改善 (#5300)\n- rate limit処理改善 (#5304)\n- 新タグ: &#96;rust-v0.47.0&#96;\n\n### Phase 3: マージ実行と競合解決\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit merge upstream/main --no-edit\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**競合発生ファイル (11件)**:\n\n1. ✅ &#96;README.md&#96; → zapabob版を保持（独自バイリンガルREADME）\n2. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.lock&#96; → upstream版を採用（後で再生成）\n3. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96; → 両方の変更を統合\n4. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/mcp_cmd.rs&#96; → upstream新インポート追加\n5. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml&#96; → 依存関係を両方保持\n6. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96; → upstream優先（複雑な構造変更）\n7. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/config.rs&#96; → tools_deep_web_searchを保持\n8. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/lib.rs&#96; → utils_string削除（upstreamリファクタリング準拠）\n9. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/state/service.rs&#96; → 両方のフィールド保持\n10. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/core/src/tools/spec.rs&#96; → Featuresベースアーキテクチャに統合\n11. ✅ &#96;codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/rmcp_client.rs&#96; → bearer_token処理追加\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 詳細な競合解決内容\n\n### 1. Cargo.toml (Workspace Dependencies)\n\n**競合内容**:\n- zapabob: &#96;audit&#96; crate\n- upstream: &#96;feedback&#96; crate\n\n**解決方法**: 両方を保持\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[workspace]",

        "contents": "# Codex - Upstream同期と独自機能維持実装ログ\n\n**実装日時**: 2025-10-19  \n**担当**: zapabob Codex AI Agent  \n**対象リポジトリ**: zapabob/codex (fork of OpenAI/codex)\n\n---\n\n## 📋 概要\n\nOpenAI公式リポジトリ（upstream）と整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持するための大規模マージ作業を実施。\n\n### 🎯 目標\n\n1. upstream/main (OpenAI/codex) の最新変更を取り込む\n2. zapabob独自機能を完全に保持\n3. 競合を適切に解決してビルド可能な状態を維持\n4. 将来的なPR作成の基礎を確立\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 作業前の状況分析\n\n### Gitリモート設定\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\norigin: https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git\nupstream: https://github.com/openai/codex.git (既に設定済み)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### ブランチ状況\n\n- **current**: &#96;main&#96; ブランチ\n- **zapabob/codex**: 176個の独自コミット\n- **OpenAI/codex**: 50個の新規コミット（未取得）\n\n### 独自機能の確認\n\n✅ **保持すべき主要機能**:\n\n1. **サブエージェントシステム** (&#96;.codex/agents/&#96;)\n   - code-reviewer.yaml\n   - codex-mcp-researcher.yaml\n   - python-reviewer.yaml\n   - researcher.yaml\n   - sec-audit.yaml\n   - test-gen.yaml\n   - ts-reviewer.yaml\n   - unity-reviewer.yaml\n\n2. **自動オーケストレーション機能**\n   - TaskAnalyzer (タスク複雑度自動判定)\n   - AutoOrchestrator (サブエージェント自律並列実行)\n   - ThreeWayMerge実装\n\n3. **Deep Research拡張**\n   - 多段探索エンジン\n   - 引用必須レポート\n   - 矛盾検出機能\n\n4. **独自スクリプト群** (&#96;zapabob/scripts/&#96;)\n   - ビルドモニタリング (tqdm風進捗表示)\n   - 音声通知システム\n   - 実機テストツール\n\n5. **TypeScript SDK拡張** (&#96;zapabob/sdk/typescript/&#96;)\n   - Orchestrator拡張\n   - ストリーミング最適化\n\n6. **詳細ドキュメント** (&#96;zapabob/docs/&#96;)\n   - 日英バイリンガル documentation",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "// Custom Command System for calling subagents and tools\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\n\n/// Custom command definition\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CustomCommand {\n    /// Command name (e.g., \"analyze_code\", \"security_review\")\n    pub name: String,\n\n    /// Description of what the command does\n    pub description: String,\n\n    /// Target subagent type (if applicable)\n    pub subagent: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Custom parameters\n    pub parameters: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,\n\n    /// Pre-hook commands to run before execution\n    pub pre_hooks: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Post-hook commands to run after execution\n    pub post_hooks: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl CustomCommand {\n    pub fn new(name: String, description: String) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            name,\n            description,\n            subagent: None,\n            parameters: HashMap::new(),\n            pre_hooks: Vec::new(),\n            post_hooks: Vec::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_subagent(mut self, subagent: String) -&gt; Self {\n        self.subagent = Some(subagent);\n        self\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_parameter(mut self, key: String, value: String) -&gt; Self {\n        self.parameters.insert(key, value);\n        self\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_pre_hook(mut self, command: String) -&gt; Self {\n        self.pre_hooks.push(command);\n        self\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_post_hook(mut self, command: String) -&gt; Self {\n        self.post_hooks.push(command);\n        self\n    }\n}\n\n/// Custom command registry\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CustomCommandRegistry {\n    commands: HashMap&lt;String, CustomCommand&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl CustomCommandRegistry {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self",

        },
        "contents": "//! LINE Communicator for Remote Development\n//!\n//! Enables bidirectional communication via LINE for remote development\n//! Features:\n//! - LINE messaging integration\n//! - Remote command execution\n//! - File upload/download via LINE\n//! - Real-time development collaboration\n\nuse crate::Result;\nuse reqwest::Client;\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot};\n\n/// LINE message types\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum LineMessageType {\n    Text,\n    Image,\n    File,\n    Location,\n    Sticker,\n}\n\n/// LINE message structure\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct LineMessage {\n    pub message_id: String,\n    pub message_type: LineMessageType,\n    pub text: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub sender_id: String,\n    pub sender_name: String,\n    pub timestamp: i64,\n    pub reply_token: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Development command from LINE\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum DevelopmentCommand {\n    ExecuteCode { code: String, language: String },\n    CreateFile { path: String, content: String },\n    ReadFile { path: String },\n    RunTests,\n    DeployApp,\n    StatusCheck,\n    CustomCommand { command: String, args: Vec&lt;String&gt; },\n}\n\n/// LINE API response\n#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]\nstruct LineApiResponse {\n    #[serde(rename = \"message\")]\n    message: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// LINE Communicator configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct LineConfig {\n    pub channel_access_token: String,\n    pub channel_secret: String,\n    pub webhook_url: String,\n}\n\n/// LINE Communicator\npub struct LineCommunicator {\n    config: LineConfig,\n    client: Client,\n    active_sessions: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;HashMap&lt;String, DevelopmentSession&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    command_tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender&lt;CommunicationCommand&gt;,\n    command_rx: Arc&lt;Mutex&lt;Option&lt;mpsc::UnboundedReceiver&lt;CommunicationCommand&gt;&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Development session for each user\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]",

        "contents": "//! Development mode selection and history analysis\n//!\n//! Provides functionality to select between central orchestration and git worktree\n//! parallel development modes, with support for analyzing past implementation logs\n//! and commit history.\n\nuse crate::orchestration::conflict_resolver::MergeStrategy;\nuse crate::plan::ExecutionMode;\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse chrono::DateTime;\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::info;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\n/// Development mode configuration\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum DevelopmentMode {\n    /// Central orchestration with conflict resolution\n    /// Uses ConflictResolver for deadlock and conflict prevention\n    Central {\n        /// Merge strategy for conflict resolution\n        merge_strategy: MergeStrategy,\n        /// Enable dynamic conflict detection\n        dynamic_conflict_detection: bool,\n        /// Enable QC agent for quality analysis\n        enable_qc: bool,\n    },\n    /// Git worktree parallel development\n    /// Uses WorktreeManager for isolated parallel development\n    Worktree {\n        /// Number of parallel worktrees\n        num_worktrees: usize,\n        /// Auto-merge winner after competition\n        auto_merge_winner: bool,\n        /// Enable QC agent for quality analysis\n        enable_qc: bool,\n    },\n}\n\nimpl Default for DevelopmentMode {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::Central {\n            merge_strategy: MergeStrategy::ThreeWayMerge,\n            dynamic_conflict_detection: true,\n            enable_qc: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl DevelopmentMode {\n    /// Convert to plan execution mode.",

        "contents": "//! Git worktree manager for competition-style development\n//!\n//! Creates isolated worktrees for each AI agent to work independently,\n//! then merges the best result back to the main branch.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct WorktreeInfo {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub path: PathBuf,\n    pub branch: String,\n    pub agent: String,\n}\n\npub struct WorktreeManager {\n    repo_path: PathBuf,\n    worktree_base: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl WorktreeManager {\n    pub fn new(repo_path: impl AsRef&lt;Path&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let repo_path = repo_path.as_ref().to_path_buf();\n        let worktree_base = repo_path.join(\".codex-worktrees\");\n\n        // Create worktree base directory if it doesn't exist\n        if !worktree_base.exists() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(&amp;worktree_base)\n                .context(\"Failed to create worktree base directory\")?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            repo_path,\n            worktree_base,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new worktree for an agent\n    pub fn create_worktree(&amp;self, agent_name: &amp;str, task_id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;WorktreeInfo&gt; {\n        let branch_name = format!(\"codex/{agent_name}/{task_id}\");\n        let worktree_name = format!(\"{agent_name}_{task_id}\");",

        "contents": " target_branch: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        // Switch to target branch\n        let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .current_dir(&amp;self.repo_path)\n            .args([\"checkout\", target_branch])\n            .output()\n            .context(\"Failed to checkout target branch\")?;\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n            anyhow::bail!(\"Git checkout failed: {stderr}\");\n        }\n\n        // Merge worktree branch\n        let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .current_dir(&amp;self.repo_path)\n            .args([\"merge\", &amp;worktree_info.branch, \"--no-ff\"])\n            .output()\n            .context(\"Failed to merge worktree\")?;\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n            anyhow::bail!(\"Git merge failed: {stderr}\");\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Clean up all managed worktrees\n    pub fn cleanup_all(&amp;self) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        let worktrees = self.list_worktrees()?;\n\n        for worktree in worktrees {\n            self.remove_worktree(&amp;worktree.name)?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "impl WorktreeManager {\n    /// Create a new worktree manager\n    pub fn new(repo_root: PathBuf, worktree_base: PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&amp;worktree_base)\n            .context(\"Failed to create worktree base directory\")?;\n\n        Ok(Self {\n            repo_root,\n            worktree_base,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Create a worktree for a variant\n    pub fn create_worktree(&amp;self, variant_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n        let branch_name = format!(\"plan-competition-{variant_name}\");\n        let worktree_path = self.worktree_base.join(variant_name);\n\n        // Remove existing worktree if present\n        self.remove_worktree(&amp;worktree_path)?;\n\n        // Create new branch\n        let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .current_dir(&amp;self.repo_root)\n            .args([\"branch\", &amp;branch_name])\n            .output()\n            .context(\"Failed to create branch\")?;\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            // Branch might already exist, that's ok\n            debug!(\"Branch {} might already exist\", branch_name);\n        }\n\n        // Create worktree\n        let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .current_dir(&amp;self.repo_root)\n            .args([\n                \"worktree\",\n                \"add\",\n                worktree_path.to_str().unwrap(),\n                &amp;branch_name,\n            ])\n            .output()\n            .context(\"Failed to create worktree\")?;\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n            anyhow::bail!(\"Failed to create worktree: {stderr}\");\n        }\n\n        info!(\n            \"Created worktree for variant {}: {:?}\",\n            variant_name, worktree_path\n        );\n        Ok(worktree_path)\n    }\n\n    /// Remove a worktree\n    pub fn remove_worktree(&amp;self, worktree_path: &amp;Path) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        if !worktree_path.exists() {\n            return Ok(());\n        }",

        "contents": "//! File edit conflict resolution for multi-agent orchestration.\n//!\n//! Provides mechanisms to track and resolve conflicts when multiple agents\n//! attempt to edit the same files concurrently.\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse dashmap::DashMap;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse tokio::sync::RwLock;\nuse tracing::debug;\nuse tracing::info;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\n/// Strategy for resolving edit conflicts.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub enum MergeStrategy {\n    /// Execute edits sequentially (safe but slower)\n    Sequential,\n    /// Attempt three-way merge (faster but may fail)\n    ThreeWayMerge,\n    /// Last write wins (fast but risky)\n    LastWriteWins,\n}\n\nimpl Default for MergeStrategy {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::Sequential\n    }\n}\n\n/// Token representing permission to edit a file.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub struct EditToken {\n    /// File path being edited\n    pub file_path: PathBuf,\n    /// Agent that requested the edit\n    pub agent_name: String,\n    /// Unique edit ID\n    pub edit_id: uuid::Uuid,\n}\n\n/// A single edit operation on a file.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct EditOperation {\n    /// Agent performing the edit\n    pub agent_name: String,\n    /// Original content (before edit)\n    pub original_content: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// New content (after edit)\n    pub new_content: String,\n    /// Edit timestamp\n    pub timestamp: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n    /// Edit ID\n    pub edit_id: uuid::Uuid,\n}\n\n/// Merged content from multiple edits.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct MergedContent {\n    /// Final merged content\n    pub content: String,\n    /// Whether conflicts were detected\n    pub had_conflicts: bool,\n    /// Agents that contributed to the merge\n    pub contributors: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Result of a three-way merge operation.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]",

        "contents": "//! Conflict Detector for Git operations\n//!\n//! This module provides advanced conflict detection using AST analysis\n//! and machine learning-based conflict prediction.\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse git2::Repository;\nuse serde::Deserialize;\nuse serde::Serialize;\n\nuse crate::git_lock_manager::ConflictDetectorTrait;\nuse crate::git_lock_manager::ConflictResolution;\nuse crate::git_lock_manager::GitOperation;\nuse crate::git_lock_manager::LockConflict;\nuse crate::git_lock_manager::LockEntry;\n\n/// AST-based conflict detector\npub struct AstConflictDetector {\n    /// Repository path\n    repo_path: std::path::PathBuf,\n    /// Cached AST analysis results\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    ast_cache: Arc&lt;parking_lot::Mutex&lt;BTreeMap&lt;String, AstAnalysis&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\n/// AST analysis result for a file\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct AstAnalysis {\n    /// Functions defined in the file\n    pub functions: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Structs/classes defined in the file\n    pub structs: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Imports used in the file\n    pub imports: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n    /// Last modified timestamp\n    pub modified_at: chrono::DateTime&lt;chrono::Utc&gt;,\n}\n\n/// Conflict analysis result\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct ConflictAnalysis {\n    /// Probability of semantic conflict (0.0-1.0)\n    pub semantic_conflict_prob: f64,\n    /// Overlapping code regions\n    pub overlapping_regions: Vec&lt;CodeRegion&gt;,\n    /// Suggested merge strategy\n    pub merge_strategy: MergeStrategy,\n}\n\n/// Code region information\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct CodeRegion {\n    /// Start line\n    pub start_line: usize,\n    /// End line\n    pub end_line: usize,\n    /// Region type (function, struct, etc.)\n    pub region_type: String,\n    /// Region identifier\n    pub identifier: String,\n}\n\n/// Merge strategy recommendations\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum MergeStrategy {\n    /// Automatic merge possible\n    AutoMerge,",

        "contents": " {\n        let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .current_dir(&amp;self.repo_path)\n            .args([\"worktree\", \"list\", \"--porcelain\"])\n            .output()\n            .context(\"Failed to list worktrees\")?;\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);\n            anyhow::bail!(\"Git worktree list failed: {stderr}\");\n        }\n\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stdout);\n        let mut worktrees = Vec::new();\n\n        for chunk in stdout.split(\"\\n\\n\") {\n            let lines: Vec&lt;&amp;str&gt; = chunk.lines().collect();\n            if lines.len() &lt; 2 {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let path = lines[0].trim_start_matches(\"worktree \");\n            let branch = lines[1].trim_start_matches(\"branch \");\n\n            // Only include our managed worktrees\n            if let Some(name) = Path::new(path).file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str())\n                &amp;&amp; path.contains(\".codex-worktrees\")\n            {\n                let agent = name.split('_').next().unwrap_or(\"unknown\").to_string();\n\n                worktrees.push(WorktreeInfo {\n                    name: name.to_string(),\n                    path: PathBuf::from(path),\n                    branch: branch.to_string(),\n                    agent,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(worktrees)\n    }\n\n    /// Merge a worktree branch back to main\n    pub fn merge_worktree(&amp;self, worktree_info: &amp;WorktreeInfo, target_branch: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {\n        // Switch to target branch\n        let output = Command::new(\"git\")\n            .current_dir",

          "startPosition": {},

            "line": 44,
            "column": 20
          }
        },
        "contents": "use std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::Command;\n\nuse anyhow::Context;\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse anyhow::anyhow;\nuse sha1::digest::Output;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::protocol::FileChange;\n\nconst ZERO_OID: &amp;str = \"0000000000000000000000000000000000000000\";\nconst DEV_NULL: &amp;str = \"/dev/null\";\n\nstruct BaselineFileInfo {\n    path: PathBuf,\n    content: Vec&lt;u8&gt;,\n    mode: FileMode,\n    oid: String,\n}\n\n/// Tracks sets of changes to files and exposes the overall unified diff.\n/// Internally, the way this works is now:\n/// 1. Maintain an in-memory baseline snapshot of files when they are first seen.\n///    For new additions, do not create a baseline so that diffs are shown as proper additions (using /dev/null).\n/// 2. Keep a stable internal filename (uuid) per external path for rename tracking.\n/// 3.
